uv_convention: Blender UV, origin bottom-left, rect = [u0, v0, u1, v1]. 'ink' = tight box of the letters; map your plate's full face to 'ink' so the marking fills it edge to edge, or to 'slot' for a margin. glyph 'up' = +v.

pds_wand_white.where: copper lower wand front face. Reads top->bottom along the wand; seen from the front the glyph tops face the viewer's right (text rotated 90 deg CW). Hero: ink length ~245 px / 1.559 = ~157 mm, cap height ~11 mm.

pds_band_dark.where: handheld: brushed silver band directly under the Shark plate, horizontal, centred. Hero: band ~90 px = 58 mm wide, ink fills ~85 % -> ~49 mm long, ~3.5 mm cap height.

shark_white.where: handheld front grey plate (above the band), and the dark plate on the handle top (sn-gal1). Hero: ink width ~62 px = ~40 mm on the handheld.

shark_neck.where: floorhead neck/yoke top plate in front of the wand knuckle (printed light grey). Hero: ink width ~58 px = ~37 mm.

turbopro_detect.where: floorhead smoked brushroll window, left of centre, horizontal, on the window's front face. Hero: ink width ~120 px / 1.6 = ~75 mm, starts ~22 mm from the window's left end.

display_icons.where: handheld UI screen (rear of the handheld, above the handle, per owner's guide p.7): eco leaf / detect rings / boost swirl / drop icons, light bar, battery icon. Map onto the M_Screen face (decal plate 0.2 mm above). Ink brightness encodes lit vs unlit (grey) as drawn in the guide; lit glyph colour #9fcbe6 (ref-director median of the Sagewood display glyphs, light ice-blue).

dock_moon.where: dock: Quiet-mode moon icon above the slide switch (owner's guide p.16). Cell = the dock agent's existing square 8.5 mm quad (u 0.875-1, v 0-0.125); the 256x128 px cell is drawn PRE-STRETCHED 2:1 so it reads round on that square quad (pixelAspect 2).
